activities.title: 7 ежедневных заданий
activities.conditionHtml:
1. 24.09: припарковаться на любом Car Meet.
  2. 25.09: выполнить 3 Speed Skills.
  3. 26.09: сфотографировать любую машину.
  4. 27.09: потратить 15 000 CR на улучшение любой машины.
  5. 28.09: использовать Wheelspin или Super Wheelspin.
  6. 29.09: получить хотя бы 1 звезду на Speed Trap.
  7. 30.09: завершить 1 круг на любом Time Attack circuit.
Награда за каждое: 5 000 CR.
activities.howHtml: Каждое Daily открывается в 21:30 по Красноярску и остаётся доступным 7 дней.

en.reportTitle: Forza Horizon 6: Series 5 "British Automotive" — Winter Guide

activity_01_weekly.title: Weekly Challenge
activity_01_weekly.conditionHtml: In the 2010 Jaguar C-X75: take a photo, complete Road Races and visit a Car Meet. Reward: 25,000 CR.
activity_01_weekly.howHtml: Complete chapters in the order shown in-game; the exact additional requirements await the full tile.
activity_01_weekly.tuneHtml: No tune has been verified in the sources.

activity_02_daily.title: 7 Daily Challenges
activity_02_daily.conditionHtml:
1. 24 Sep: park at any Car Meet.
  2. 25 Sep: earn 3 Speed Skills.
  3. 26 Sep: photograph any car.
  4. 27 Sep: spend 15,000 CR upgrading any car.
  5. 28 Sep: use a Wheelspin or Super Wheelspin.
  6. 29 Sep: earn at least 1 star at a Speed Trap.
  7. 30 Sep: complete 1 lap at any Time Attack circuit.
Reward for each: 5,000 CR.
activity_02_daily.howHtml: Each Daily opens at 21:30 Krasnoyarsk time and remains available for 7 days.

activity_03_photo.title: #BambooPerfect
activity_03_photo.conditionHtml: Photograph any McLaren in Bamboo Forest. Reward: Karate Master emote.
activity_03_photo.howHtml: Open Photo Mode in Bamboo Forest, make sure the McLaren is in frame, then save the photo.

activity_04_treasure_hunt.title: Treasure Hunt
activity_04_treasure_hunt.conditionHtml: Follow the photo clue and find the treasure in the Shimanoyama region. Reward: 100,000 CR.
activity_04_treasure_hunt.howHtml: The exact clue and chest location await the full in-game tile or a fresh Winter guide.

activity_05_championship.title: Country Pickups
activity_05_championship.conditionHtml: Country Pickups Championship: Pickups & 4x4, B 600. Routes: Soni Highlands Cross Country, Temple Cross Country, with the third route not yet confirmed. Reward: 2010 Jaguar C-X75.
activity_05_championship.howHtml: Complete the championship; the exact route list will be verified from the in-game tile.
activity_05_championship.tuneHtml: No tune has been verified in the sources.

activity_06_championship.title: Cult Street
activity_06_championship.conditionHtml: Cult Street Championship: Cult Cars, D 500. Routes: Rainbow Bridge Descent, Okishinaimura Run, Norikura Descent. Reward: 1972 Reliant Supervan III.
activity_06_championship.howHtml: Finish all three races while keeping clean checkpoint lines.
activity_06_championship.tuneHtml: No tune has been verified in the sources.

activity_07_pr.title: Shimanoyama Drift Attack
activity_07_pr.conditionHtml: Shimanoyama Drift Attack: United Kingdom, A 800, at least 80,000 points.
activity_07_pr.howHtml: Score across the full Drift Attack distance and avoid breaking your drift chain.
activity_07_pr.tuneHtml: No tune has been verified in the sources.

activity_08_pr.title: Azure Drive Danger Sign
activity_08_pr.conditionHtml: Azure Drive Danger Sign: United Kingdom, B 700, at least 689.0 ft.
activity_08_pr.howHtml: Build speed on a straight approach to the ramp; the exact approach will be confirmed by the in-game tile.
activity_08_pr.tuneHtml: No tune has been verified in the sources.

activity_09_pr.title: Tall Trees Speed Zone
activity_09_pr.conditionHtml: Tall Trees Speed Zone: United Kingdom, A 800, at least 70.0 mph.
activity_09_pr.howHtml: Build speed before the entry and keep a smooth line through the zone.
activity_09_pr.tuneHtml: No tune has been verified in the sources.

activity_10_pr.title: Sekibe Kaijo Trailblazer
activity_10_pr.conditionHtml: Sekibe Kaijo Trailblazer: United Kingdom, A 800, at least 42 seconds remaining.
activity_10_pr.howHtml: Start with a speed reserve and follow the shortest safe route to the finish.
activity_10_pr.tuneHtml: No tune has been verified in the sources.

activity_11_trial.title: Winter Rallies
activity_11_trial.conditionHtml: The Trial Winter Rallies: Rally Monsters, A 800. Routes: Bamboo Forest Scramble, Ine Scramble, Ito Trail. Reward: 1986 MG Metro 6R4.
activity_11_trial.howHtml: Drive cleanly as a team and do not push teammates off their line.
activity_11_trial.tuneHtml: No tune has been verified in the sources.

activity_12_horizon_play.title: Speed Connection
activity_12_horizon_play.conditionHtml: In Horizon Racing, earn 3 LINK Speed Skills. Reward: 1962 Peel P50.
activity_12_horizon_play.howHtml: Start a Horizon Racing event and maintain a chain of speed skills.

activity_13_horizon_play.title: Horizon Stunt Party
activity_13_horizon_play.conditionHtml: Complete Mini Games in Horizon Stunt Party. Reward: Black and Red Utility Pants.
activity_13_horizon_play.howHtml: Reach the event results screen; leaving early does not count.

activity_14_monthly_rivals.title: Monthly Rivals — Shimanoyama Sprint
activity_14_monthly_rivals.conditionHtml: Monthly Rivals: set a clean lap on Shimanoyama Sprint in the 2025 McLaren W1.
activity_14_monthly_rivals.howHtml: Finish the lap without collisions or penalties.
